title: The merge door with thousands of kept places keeps its live read; an apply without it refuses
steps: Run the live-sync-flow cases for #287 (real MariaDB): 8000 titles changed on both sides plus one live-only edit, then merge and apply; and an apply whose live read was removed.
expect: The merge answers ready with 8000 kept places and live/db.sql.gz still exists; the apply is ok, the live edit is on the copy and the next sync is unchanged: merge.
The apply without its read answers ok:false NOT_MERGED and the copy is unchanged.
evidence: Issue #287: line 1697 Argument list too long, then cp: cannot stat live/db.sql.gz

tests: `merge` then `apply` with thousands of kept places
an `apply` whose live read is gone refuses
